title: Serve everything
prompt: The robot works through the whole order queue, front first, calling out each order as it is served. An empty queue prints nothing.
hints: A while loop that keeps going while the queue has something left, taking the front order with pop_front and printing it.

docs.name: while condition:
docs.what: Repeats the indented lines as long as the condition stays true.

docs.name: list.pop_front()
docs.what: Removes the first item and returns it.

docs.name: list.size()
docs.what: Returns how many items the array holds.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.
